video_title: Scottie Barnes' Dream Teammate Becomes Reality

quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes names Kawhi Leonard as his dream teammate
quotes.excerpt: I'll say it would be Kawhi Leonard.
quotes.quote: I'll say it would be Kawhi Leonard.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes says Kawhi Leonard is his dream teammate.

quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes on Kawhi Leonard's impact and legacy
quotes.excerpt: I think it's pretty crazy knowing what he's done in this league and his history.
quotes.quote: I think it's pretty crazy knowing what he's done in this league and his history. It's just big, great things that happened.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes on Kawhi Leonard: It is crazy knowing what he has done in this league and his history.

quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes explains why Kawhi Leonard is the ideal teammate
quotes.excerpt: I think he fits like the prototypical player that you would want to play with.
quotes.quote: I think he fits like the prototypical player that you would want to play with. He guards, strong, physical, just so consistent. His game is just constantly growing and I think that makes it pretty exciting to play with.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes calls Kawhi Leonard the prototypical player you want to play with because he is consistent and physical.

quotes.speaker: Kawhi Leonard
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard on Scottie Barnes' growth and potential
quotes.excerpt: He's doing it great by himself, so it's just small details. He's already taking leaps by himself.
quotes.quote: He's doing it great by himself, so it's just small details. He's already taking leaps by himself. Everything is going to be on him and on how he gets better. I'm just helping like 0.001%.
quotes.social_post: Kawhi Leonard on Scottie Barnes: He is already taking leaps by himself. I am just helping like 0.001 percent.

quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes on the mutual support between him and Kawhi Leonard
quotes.excerpt: This is our team. I'm going to help him with his game, he's going with my game.
quotes.quote: This is our team. I'm going to help him with his game, he's going with my game as well.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes on his partnership with Kawhi Leonard: This is our team. I am going to help him with his game and he is going to help with mine.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković on the complementary games of Barnes and Leonard
quotes.excerpt: They have a lot of similarities in their games and I think they're going to complement each other.
quotes.quote: They have a lot of similarities in their games and I think they're going to complement each other a lot.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic believes Scottie Barnes and Kawhi Leonard have similar games and will complement each other well.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Webster
quotes.summary_phrase: Bobby Webster on the defensive value of Barnes and Leonard
quotes.excerpt: It starts with defense for both of them. Two big, two-way wings have always been valuable.
quotes.quote: It starts with defense for both of them. Two big, two-way wings have always been valuable skill sets for us. But on the defensive end, when they both want to lock in and turn it up, they should be a menace.
quotes.social_post: Bobby Webster says Barnes and Leonard will be a menace on the defensive end when they both lock in.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković on the importance of star players to coaching success
quotes.excerpt: Phil Jackson would not be Phil Jackson if he did not have Michael Jordan, Kobe Bryant.
quotes.quote: Phil Jackson would not be Phil Jackson if he did not have Michael Jordan, he would not have Kobe Bryant. And I'm hopeful and I'm believer that that can be for me and my career can be Scottie.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic compares his relationship with Scottie Barnes to Phil Jackson and Michael Jordan: I am a believer that that can be for me and my career.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković predicts Scottie Barnes will make All-Defensive team
quotes.excerpt: What he's going to achieve this year, he's going to be in the first team all defensive team.
quotes.quote: What he's going to achieve this year, he's going to be in the first team all defensive team. Last year he ended up being in the second team and I think that was not fair.
quotes.social_post: Darko Rajakovic says it was not fair that Scottie Barnes only made the second team all defensive team last year and predicts he will make the first team this year.

quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes on his defensive ability and stats
quotes.excerpt: I feel like I'm the best defender in the world.
quotes.quote: I feel like I'm the best defender in the world. Even if you don't watch basketball, you can just go to stats. If you don't want to go to stats, you can just go watch film. But it is what it is, can't change it. I know what I am and I think the world knows as well.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes is confident in his defensive ability: I feel like I am the best defender in the world.
